candidates.review_note: Every qualifying number is a square below10^n; enumerate only its root below10^(n/2), split at the halfway power of10, and test the defining equality. Format with exactlyn digits including leading zeroes.
Two heaps maintain the lower median of all preceding terms. Keep the lower half one element larger or equal, generate each term modulo1e9+7, and sum terms without reducing the requested sum.
Each changed duplicate can introduce one new letter. Enough duplicates exist exactly when total string length is at leastK; otherwise reachingK distinct letters is impossible.

The dictionary is supplied before the first# delimiter. Deduplicate dictionary entries and compare each word letter multiset with the puzzle multiset; letters can be unused but cannot be over-consumed.

Convert the exact exponent through high-precision log10(2), choose the ceiling exponent for normalized scientific notation, and round the mantissa to three decimals. Handle a rounded mantissa10 by renormalizing.

Global alignment DP separately tracks a gap in each sequence, charging openingA once and extensionB afterward. The overall best state allows adjacent gaps in opposite sequences as the public sample requires. Initialize prefix gaps explicitly; use linear memory.

Repeatedly merge the available nonroot block with maximum average weight into its prerequisite parent block. The scheduling exchange argument orders blocks by weight/length; merging adds parent_length*child_weight to the weighted completion cost. Compare ratios exactly by cross multiplication.
All-pairs BFS computes unweighted shortest distances. A vertex belongs to some shortest path exactly when its two endpoint distances sum to the endpoint distance; scan vertices in increasing order.

Parse the preorder full-binary cutting tree with an explicit stack. A leaf depth determines its piece length; count encountered internal nodes and retain the count at the first leaf attaining maximum depth. No recursion limit is needed for20000-symbol inputs.
